text: [15aeeca2e6298028] Main: Routing update (session-only, applies to FRESH seats; already-running seats keep their captured routes): reviewer → @m_swe; scout → @m_auto; critic → @m_auto; connector stays @m_auto. executor/sentinel → m_luna, scribe/distiller → m_haiku, labrat/revenger → m_zfl, simplifier → m_composer, mutation-tester → m_sol, task/planner → m_opus — unchanged. Keep role names in spec items, never model params. This moves reviewer+scout+critic load off the saturated zfl/luna/codex paths.
